text: なく　こも　だまらせるぜ！
note: This uses the set phrase 泣く子も黙る, "even a crying child falls silent", a stock way to call someone fearsome. The English game replaced it with "We rule the roads, man!".
claim: 泣く子も黙る is a Japanese set phrase describing someone or something so fearsome that even a crying child goes quiet.

check.quote: こわがられるほど、勢いや力があることです。
